purpose: Reproduce a genuine, public historical exploit against forked mainnet state to prove that poc/validate_finding.py reaches a real CONFIRMED on a true exploit. This is a REPLAY only, NOT a novel finding.
mechanism: Broken access control / unprotected callback-trusting function. StaxLPStaking.migrateStake(oldStaking, amount) has NO access control and blindly trusts the caller-supplied `oldStaking` address: it calls oldStaking.migrateWithdraw(msg.sender, amount) (an attacker-controlled callback) and then credits msg.sender with `amount` staked LP via _applyStake. The attacker passes their OWN contract as `oldStaking` (whose migrateWithdraw is a no-op) plus the full LP balance as `amount`, getting credited with LP they never deposited, then calls withdrawAll(false) to transfer the real LP tokens out. Single transaction.

provenance.adapted_from: Public DeFiHackLabs PoC (SunWeb3Sec/DeFiHackLabs, src/test/2022-10/Templedao_exp.sol), flattened to forge-std-only with inline interfaces and an explicit profit assertion.

validation.command: set -a && source .env && set +a && python3 poc/validate_finding.py --tx-hash 0x8c3f442fc6d640a6ff3ea0b12be64f1d4609ea94edd2966f42c01cd9bdcf04b5 --chain ethereum --fork-block 15725066 --foundry-test poc/findings/replay-templedao-access-control/Exploit.t.sol --no-splunk
validation.assertion: assertGt(gain, 0, "exploit did not reproduce: attacker gained no LP") — load-bearing, not weakened.
validation.independent_cross_check: The validator's independent cast-run re-trace of the REAL attack tx (trace_summary in validator_result.json) shows the identical flow against the real attack contract 0x2Df9c154fe24D081cfE568645Fb4075d725431e0: balanceOf(staking)=3.211e23 -> migrateStake(attacker's oldStaking, 3.211e23) -> no-op migrateWithdraw callback -> emit Staked -> withdrawAll(false) -> StaxLP::transfer of 3.211e23 to attacker -> final balanceOf(attacker)=3.211e23. Matches the PoC's reproduction in both mechanism AND amount.
